facts.text: The project simulates data collection from a virtual instrument using serial communication
The virtual instrument has temperature, voltage and current attributes
Client wraps a serial.Serial and writes a request as UTF-8 bytes followed by CRLF
read_response reads one line, decodes it and strips the surrounding whitespace
The simulated instrument dispatches the first three characters of a request as STA, TYP, VOL, TMP or CUR
STA returns a random integer from 0 to 0xFFFFFFFF
TYP returns one of a, b, c or abc
VOL returns a random integer from 0 to 220
TMP returns a random integer from 0 to 85
CUR returns a random integer from 0 to 2000
The README describes 20 temperatures, 20 voltages, 5 statuses and 30 currents per collection
collect_types sends one TYP request per iteration of range(1, 6)
The README checks temperatures above 80 degrees, voltages above 190 volts and currents outside 25 to 800 mA
check_voltages raises VoltageTooHighError above 190 volts and reports a voltage equal to 0
check_current_threshold prints a threshold alert below 25

measures.description: Read the current value of one or more sensor channels and return the values with a sampling timestamp and a monotone sequence number. Volatile channels are also available by subscription.
